items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: King Jimmy Davis, we stood there a good while with the two twins... I played there with Kid Harris. Kid Harvey played there. Most of us played there.

ctx.x: Yeah, next year's what they did.

You could pass there at 9 o'clock in the morning and still hear the band playing from the night before. That was the last rounder. That was the last band that would knock off. Everybody knocked off their still playing. The Last Rounders, the last place you could go to see the new music. Who played there? Oh, I played there several times. Yeah, I was playing there a little bit. Yeah. King Jimmy Davis, we stood there a good while with the two twins. Yeah, the trumpet player with twins. Yeah. And the drummer…
Big band banjo, little short dance.
